name: Clomiphene citrate
description: A mixture of the estrogen receptor antagonist enclomiphene and the weak agonist zuclomiphene, approved for ovulation induction in women. Use in males to raise endogenous testosterone by blocking hypothalamic estrogen feedback is off-label.

systems.note: Blocks hypothalamic estrogen negative feedback, raising gonadotropins and gonadal steroid output; placed on the gonads by intended effect rather than on the pituitary that transmits it.
Visual disturbance and mood effects are labelled; the zuclomiphene isomer accumulates.
Adverse lipid movement is described with prolonged use.

monitors.why: The endpoint of off-label male use.
The mechanism by which the compound raises androgen.
Read with LH to characterise the axis response.
Estradiol rises as the axis is driven.
